notes: The deploy-log pack does what its README says and nothing more. Its one pass reads sessions, notes and turns, runs once per note, and works only on notes matching **/Deploys*.md and **/Deploy log*.md, and the README describes these inputs, the trigger (a session-end --note or a [[...]] handoff link) and the cost accurately. The prompt marks untrusted input as data, allows only append changes under a final `## Logged deploys` section, and requires citations. Commands, which a deploy log needs, may only be copied exactly from the session's own tool_use turns, never from tool results or fetched pages, and secrets must be redacted. The prompt also forbids guessing targets or versions and forbids recording unfinished deploys as succeeded. The persona treats all its inputs as untrusted, rejects by default when evidence is thin, enforces the same command and secret rules, and keeps a strict one-sentence JSON reply format. The template holds only a heading, a neutral description and an empty section, with no instructions, commands or links. The fixtures are marked synthetic and use placeholder names (sample-api, toolu_synthetic_0001, a river book club), and the test checks that a non-matching note is not read. I found no hidden, encoded or misnamed content and no text addressed to the reviewer or the dreaming model.
